beschreibung: G9a (#319): Quartett-Set tiere, ein Bild je Karte (Anki-Medien, #270). Sachlich richtig; jede Auswahl gegen die Quelle der Karte prüfen.
stil: Painterly natural-history illustration in warm oil colours, like a plate from an old illustrated bestiary of a fairy-tale kingdom but anatomically accurate: one animal, whole body visible, in a calm characteristic pose in a softly painted hint of its natural habitat, warm even light, background slightly darker towards the edges. No clothes, no human expression. No text.
